LESSON: DIACRITICALISATION OF THE QUR’AN

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.2: Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an, part of Qur’an in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is diacriticalisation of the Qur’an important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online or from available reference materials the circumstances that led to diacriticalisation of the Qur’an (vowelling marks – tashkil and diacritical marks-i’jam) and present in class,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online or from available reference materials the circumstances that led to diacriticalisation of the Qur’an (vowelling marks – tashkil and diacritical marks-i’jam) and present in class,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking and writing are enhanced as learners brainstorm on the

significance of diacriticalisation of the Qur’an and prepare charts

• Learning to Learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners research online or from available reference

materials the circumstances that led to diacriticalisation of the Qur’an

• Digital literacy: the skills of interacting with digital technology and connecting with technology are enhanced as learners

research online or from available reference materials the circumstances that led to diacriticalisation of the Qur’an

Values:
• Respect: open mindedness is enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinion while brainstorming in groups on the

significance of diacriticalisation of the Qur’an, prepare a chart and present in class

• Unity: cooperation is attained as learners work together to prepare a chart with Quranic verses, with diacritical marks and

corresponding verses without

• Responsibility: accountability is realised as learners brainstorm on the significance of diacriticalisation of the Qur’an,

prepare charts and present in class

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: self-esteem as learners work together to prepare a chart with Quranic verses, with diacritical marks and

corresponding verses
